rising.name: Rising role
rising.rule: Under 25, snap share up 15+ points over the last 3 games, outside the top 25

open.name: Open role
open.rule: Under 26, second on his team's depth chart at his position, and the starter is old or in his contract's final year

outproducing.name: Outproducing his price
outproducing.rule: Under 26, playing most games, scoring 4+ points a game more than players at his value

contract_year.name: Contract year starter
contract_year.rule: 26 or older, starting, in the final year of his contract

aging_rb.name: Aging RB
aging_rb.rule: Running back 27 or older, still valued as a top-100 player
